plain: A language model fresh from its first training on lots of text, before anyone has taught it to follow instructions or act as an assistant.
eli5: A kid who has read the whole library but has not yet learned how to answer when someone asks a question.
technical: A model trained only to predict the next token over a large text corpus, with no instruction tuning or RLHF; in Constitutional AI it is the model fine-tuned on revisions in the supervised stage and the default feedback model in the RL stage.
